propositions: The tests overlay (blocking at 0.54) is currently selected only by glob match on test files, missing cases where source files add product declarations without test changes, allowing bugs like git_adapter regressions to merge unapproved.

The detector must fire when a diff adds a declaration (def/class/func/function in any language) in any file except under tests/ globs, and the declared name is not simultaneously removed in the same file, suppressing annotation-only rewrites and failing closed on anonymous declarations.

The implementation adds a keyword-only changed_files parameter to content_triggered_overlays and a new _has_added_declaration helper using the existing polyglot _REMOVED_DECL_RE regex plus a separate name-extraction regex, with per-file provenance from diff headers to handle moves correctly.

Guard (vii) in code-review-tests.md must be narrowed so coverage gaps are blocking-eligible only when their implementing lines appear as ADDED lines in the diff and the finding names a concrete violating input, distinguishing newly-introduced from pre-existing behaviour.

The detector is path-blind and language-agnostic, with no src/ or Python-only predicates, firing identically for Go, Ruby, TypeScript, Java or .NET targets, and skipping only docs and config file extensions.
